description: Researcher roles offered in the calculator. Each role is shown by its US label, followed by its local label when local_labels has one for the chosen country (keyed by the country codes in country.json). sector is "university" or "public_research". hourly_rate_usd is the preset hourly rate of labor including indirect on-costs in US dollars, converted to the chosen country's currency when a role is selected. The rates below are median US rates, with sources provided.
